meaning:
διδακτός, -ή, -όν
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Isa.54:13 (לִמּוּד), 1Ma.4:7 * ;]
1. that can be taught.
2. taught; with genitive, of source of teaching (in cl., poët. only);
(a) of persons: δ. θεοῦ, Jhn.6:45 (LXX);
(b) of things, λόγοις δ. πνεύματος, 1Co.2:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
